errors.quote: On externally written cases the pass band drops to 28–51%.
errors.paper_says: The deterministic pass band drops to 28–33% on the external-authored subset (Table 2 caption, p. 6; Table 17, p. 22: Lethe 33.8, LangGraph 32.5, Mem0 28.6). The 45.5 and 50.6 figures in that table are the LLM-hook variants (Lethe+LLM, LangGraph+LLM), not part of the band.

errors.quote: Mem0 with its LLM router passes 43.6% and Graphiti 7.0% ([p. 6, Table 2]
errors.paper_says: Both numbers are in the paper, but not in Table 2 on p. 6. Table 2 has no Graphiti column and its Mem0 column is the infer=False run at 68.3%. Mem0 infer=True at 168/385 (43.6%) is in the Limitations and its appendix table (PDF pp. 10–11, 21); Graphiti at 17/242 (7.0%) is in Appendix N (p. 19–20).

asis-v2-q1-r2.review_only: I checked the numbers below in the papers, except EvoMemBench's, which comes from its note.
asis-v2-q1-r2.comment: Broadest coverage, and the only answer with MemSyco-Bench, the o4-mini length collapse and HorizonBench's short-history result. Extra claims check out in the papers: Zep 7.0/3.0 on MemoryAgentBench FC-SH/FC-MH (Table 3), BEAM contradiction resolution at most 0.053 (Table 1, p. 8), LightMem's irreversible-deletion argument (5.6, p. 9), κ = 0.126 (p. 5), 37–40% for agentic search (p. 17), 12 systems and two MemTensor authors in 'Are We Ready'. Points 5, 14, 18, 19 and 20 are counted on partial statements: A gives the core number or claim but not the 3B model, the 96-vs-54 retention gap, HippoRAG or MemPalace. Point 17 is not counted because A gives Mem0's 43.6% without saying the write-time LLM is what hurts. The MemoryBank point is also flagged 'per its note'.

errors.quote: on cases from other benchmarks the gain shrinks to 12–18 points
errors.paper_says: The +11.7 (Lethe) and +18.1 (LangGraph) lifts are on the external-authored 77-case subset, written by four outside contributors under ForgetEval's own category schema (Table 17 and 'What the external subset shows', p. 22). They are not cases taken from other benchmarks.

asis-v2-q1-r1.review_only: The ForgetEval, MemoryAgentBench, EvoMemBench and Fundamental Problems numbers come from the library's notes; I did not reopen those papers.
asis-v2-q1-r1.comment: Shortest answer; the numbers it gives match the papers and its page citations hold (DynamicMem Fig. 8 on pp. 10–11, Stale 91%/32% on p. 1, PersonaMem-v3 p. 17, model editing Table 4 on p. 14). Belief Memory's 0.25 is in Appendix A.2 (p. 12) and on p. 6, while the link goes to section 3.3 (p. 5), which describes the merge; I did not count that as an error. Point 6 is not counted: Zep is only named with 'validity intervals', without the invalidation mechanism. Point 2 is counted on a thin statement (the three labels, and that they are added to Graphiti/Zep). Not checked: 'MEMIT has no delete operation' and 'single-run'. Leaves out HorizonBench, MemSyco-Bench, HaluMem and Mem0's write-time mechanism.

errors.quote: On cases drawn from other benchmarks the LLM-hook gain shrinks to 12–18 points.
errors.paper_says: The +11.7 and +18.1 lifts are on the external-authored 77-case subset: four outside contributors wrote 20 cases each under ForgetEval's category schema (Table 17, p. 22). The cases are not drawn from other benchmarks.

asis-v2-q1-r3.review_only: The other numbers come from the full-read notes in `notes/`, not from reopening the papers.
asis-v2-q1-r3.comment: Most complete on mechanisms: the only answer with Mem0's 10-neighbour write-time choice, HaluMem's update omission, and the reason Mem0 with inference drops to 43.6%. Extra claims check out: LightMem 67.78 → 65.39 after the offline update (Table 2, r=0.6, th=256, GPT-4o-mini), BEAM at most 0.053, Belief Memory tested on LoCoMo and ALFWorld with the old value kept as a historical entry, A-TMA's ablation on profiles 000–002 (p. 20), qwen2.5:3b as the answer model, Memanto's conflict mechanism described but not evaluated. One loose label, not counted as an error: the heading 'Append-only stores return the old fact' is illustrated with Mem0 and Letta, which the paper calls fact-extraction plugins, and Mem0 is not append-only by C's own table. Not checked: 'neither ablates its update step', 'listed as open by every survey here', and the remark that Mem0's numbers suggest a configuration problem.
